summary: The figure faithfully presents the segmented focus bar with the History reconstruction segment highlighted and associated callout, effectively supporting the message that more efficient visits increase supply.
suggestedUpgrades: Consider slightly increasing the contrast or font weight on the 'Why this matters' callout bullet points to improve legibility at a distance without overpowering the main focal segment.
The bar label 'TYPICAL VISIT' could be made marginally larger or darker to improve reading ease without stealing focus.
The callout's border radius and shadow appear consistent but a subtle increase in shadow softness might enhance the premium feel.
